judge.rationale: The candidate only generated the specification (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`), definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`), and acceptance tests (`registry.acceptance.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`), stopping completely before implementing the feature itself. `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` is untouched, `ajv` was not added to `package.json`, and none of the documentation or changelog files (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) were updated. Because the implementation is missing, all the newly added tests will fail. Additionally, the ticket specifically asked for `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, whereas the candidate created `.acceptance.test.ts` files instead.
